name: Vault door
notes3d: Door and frame as one mesh, lock wheel a separate emissive mesh so a script can spin it. Pivot at the bottom centre, front faces -Z. Should read as safe and friendly, not menacing.
purpose: The chunky round door to the vault, where critters are safe and earn 50%; raiders cannot touch it.
